name: NEFW Title
epitaph: NEFW's top championship. Tommy McKnight took it from Blade on the February 2002 Nemesis, drew with him at State of Shock, and lost it back to Blade six days later, Blade's fourth reign by the broadcast's own count. Senton held it by the Body Count pay-per-view of June, keeping it against his own brother Corona. The federation's own September handbook renamed the belt the NEFW Title, calling it representative of the Champion of the Federation rather than a claim to world status, and that October's tournament for it ran through a Doctor Melancholy-Hannibal final the served cards do not carry the result of.

name: NEFW North American Championship
epitaph: The NEFW's second singles championship. Corona turned back Chris Rogers and Inferno in February 2002 before losing the belt to Scourge on the Sanitarium of that month; Scourge held it past the Senator three days later.

name: NEFW Television Championship
epitaph: Defended on every televised programme. Senton kept it on a forfeit in February 2002 and lost it inside a steel cage to White Lightning Chris Rogers on the Sanitarium of that month; Rogers kept it on a double count-out against Rude Dude.

name: NEFW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: The NEFW's cruiserweight championship. Raptor held it across February 2002, turning back Rasco Raines by count-out and Speedy Irons by pinfall.

name: NEFW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The NEFW's tag team championship. The New Broncos, London Tower and Lightning Kid, held it through February 2002, beating Joey Steroidz and a masked partner and keeping it on a disqualification against the Senator and Hannibal.

name: NEFW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: The NEFW's hardcore championship. Christian Cable held it into late February 2002 and beat Vigilante to keep it.

name: NEFW Unified Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: An old NEFW championship restored to active competition. Tommy McKnight beat the reigning Butcher Ben in a two-out-of-three-falls match to take the belt on the federation's last card before scaling back its operation, and kept it against the Crimson Christian on Impact two and a half weeks later.

name: NEFW New England State Championship
epitaph: A regional NEFW singles championship. Butcher Ben held it into a Boiler Room match against Scourge at Body Count and kept it, both men carried from the arena.

name: NEFW Rage Championship
epitaph: A new NEFW championship geared toward the cruiserweight division, announced in the federation's own September handbook. Its first match was set for Day of the Dead, Ripper and Xara against the Goth and a tag partner chosen by lottery, the winning team then facing off for the belt.
